name: Zuccarello (Italy)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, yellow above and red below, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Zuccarello (three white sugar loaves on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Zuccarello, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.
